description:
List your organization's most recent PromptGuard security events: what was blocked, redacted, flagged or allowed, with the threat types, confidence, direction, surface, provider, project id and each finding's detector and rule. Newest first, at most 50. Filter by decision, threat type, project (by id, or by the name the User gave) or a start time. Only PromptGuard's own values are returned: never an event's prompt text, reason, model or names. Read-only.
When to use: To investigate what PromptGuard caught recently, to check whether a project is seeing attacks, or to find the event and rule behind a Suppression the User asks for on a project they name (pass project_name, rather than listing projects).

decision.description: Only events with one of these decisions

project_name.description: Only events in the project with this name, as the User typed it (case ignored). Not with project_id.

since.description: Only events at or after this time (ISO 8601; UTC if no zone)

threat_type.description: Only events of this threat type, e.g. prompt_injection or pii_leak

name: promptguard_list_events
title: List security events
